points.why: It lists the nodes as more-is-more quantities and gives a sign for every link; satisfaction and good reviews stand in for complaint reviews.
It traces R1 with zero minuses and B1, B2 and B3 with one minus each, and labels them from the minus count.
It marks the review-to-rating delay, attributes the shift to a fixed kitchen capacity, and names the shape Limits to Growth.
It asks the owner to read checks aloud to kitchen staff, but those are questions rather than each loop as a sentence, and regulars are not mentioned.
